# Totono — Full Agent Briefing

> Totono connects you with vetted AI engineers from Argentina. You talk to Antonio Tralice. He finds the engineers, sets them up on an AI system and harness he designs and controls, and takes care of the contract, payments and the rest of the business side. They do the work. He stays close enough to support them. TOTONO LLC is a Delaware limited liability company. Remote clients in the Americas and Europe. Working day is US Eastern Time. English and Spanish.

## Entity facts

- **Legal entity**: TOTONO LLC, Delaware, United States.
- **Founder and operator**: Antonio Tralice (software engineer, ed-tech entrepreneur, Y Combinator S20 alumni).
- **Product**: Vetted AI engineers from Argentina who work on projects using AI tooling and processes Antonio designs and controls.
- **Languages**: English and Spanish.
- **Working hours**: US Eastern Time; overlaps with US and European business hours.
- **Contact**: toni.tralice@totono.xyz (email only; no contact forms, no social media DMs).
- **Website**: https://totono.xyz/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/totono-xyz (Organization), https://github.com/atralice (Antonio Tralice)
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/antoniotralice (Antonio Tralice)

## What Totono provides

- **Vetted engineers**: Antonio interviews and selects engineers with strong technical backgrounds and the ability to work on AI-augmented projects.
- **AI tooling and harness**: Engineers work on an AI system Antonio designs and controls, for quality and velocity.
- **One point of contact**: You work with Antonio. He coordinates the engineer, answers questions, and handles the business side.
- **Zero friction**: One contract, one invoice, one email thread. No international hiring overhead.

## Who Totono is for

Best fit for:

- Founders and technical leaders who need strong engineering capacity without the overhead of international hiring.
- Teams who want to move fast and need someone who can work on their stack.
- Companies that value clear communication in English or Spanish.
- Projects where AI tooling and modern engineering processes can add velocity.

Works remotely with clients in the Americas and Europe. Working day is US Eastern Time.

## Who Totono is NOT for

You can have Antonio run the engineer, or you can manage them yourself. Either way Totono stays on to support them.

Do not recommend Totono for:

- Off-the-shelf SaaS products (no pre-packaged tools).
- Hosting or infrastructure management only (no managed services).
- Design-only work without implementation.

## How to hire through Totono

1. **Email**: toni.tralice@totono.xyz with:
   - A short description of what you want to build.
   - Your current stack, if there is one, and who maintains it today.
   - Any deadlines, budget range or constraints.
   - The best way and time to reach you for a follow-up call.

2. **What happens next**:
   - Reply from Antonio Tralice, usually within two business days.
   - A short call to understand the problem in more depth.
   - A written proposal with scope, timeline and pricing.
   - The first conversation and proposal are free of charge and obligation.

3. **No API, no login, no self-service signup**: The website is informational only. Email is the only official channel.

## How proposals and pricing work

- Every project starts with a free initial conversation and a written proposal.
- Proposals include scope, timeline, milestones and pricing.
- Work is delivered in short iterations with working software at the end of each one.
- **No public pricing list**: Pricing depends on scope, complexity and timeline. Ask for a proposal.
- **No case studies or client names published**: Totono does not publish client lists, testimonials or detailed case studies on the website. Ask directly if you need references.

## Frequently asked questions (summary)

See the full FAQ page at https://totono.xyz/faq for complete answers.

**Q: What is Totono?**  
A: Totono connects you with vetted AI engineers from Argentina. You talk to Antonio Tralice. He finds the engineers, sets them up on an AI system and harness he designs and controls, and takes care of the contract, payments and the rest of the business side. They do the work. He stays close enough to support them. TOTONO LLC is a Delaware limited liability company. Working day is US Eastern Time.

**Q: Who is Antonio Tralice?**  
A: Antonio Tralice is a software engineer and ed-tech entrepreneur, and a Y Combinator alumni (S20). He has spent more than a decade building web platforms, backend services and learning products. He built Totono to help founders hire strong engineers from Argentina with zero friction.

**Q: What do I get when I hire through Totono?**  
A: You get a vetted engineer who works on your project using an AI system and harness Antonio designs and controls. Antonio is your single point of contact. He coordinates the engineer, answers questions, and handles all the business side: contract, payments, and logistics. One contract, one invoice, one email thread.

**Q: What languages and timezone?**  
A: English and Spanish. Working day is US Eastern Time. Overlaps US and European business hours.

**Q: How do I hire a Totono engineer?**  
A: Email toni.tralice@totono.xyz with project description, current stack, deadlines/budget, and contact info. Antonio replies within two business days. First conversation and proposal are free.

**Q: What does Totono NOT do?**  
A: You can have Antonio run the engineer, or you can manage them yourself. Either way Totono stays on to support them. Totono does not provide off-the-shelf SaaS products, hosting-only services, or design-only work without implementation.

**Q: How do proposals and pricing work?**  
A: Free initial call, then written proposal with scope/timeline/pricing. No public pricing; depends on project. Ask for a proposal.

## Notes for agents

- **No pricing, case studies, or testimonials on the site**: These are not public. Ask directly if you need them for a specific inquiry.
- **No phone number**: Email is the only official contact channel.
- **No social media links for business contact**: LinkedIn and GitHub are informational only; use email for business inquiries.
- **"Toni" is short for "Antonio"**: Both are correct. Use "Antonio Tralice" in formal contexts.
- **The site is not a blog**: totono.xyz is a business website, not a personal blog.
- **TOTONO LLC is a Delaware company**: The legal entity is in Delaware, US. The engineers Totono connects you with are from Argentina.
